summary: The exact candidate reproduces and blocks the generic 3-to-4 stale-plan path and correctly aligns DSA padding to attention TP. Its DSA exception is incomplete: it declares the stale physical extent valid after checking only dsa_cache_seqlens_int32, its two cumulative-offset arrays, and out_cache_loc. It does not validate other row-indexed metadata used downstream, and independently accepted a four-token batch with three-row dsa_seqlens_expanded and token_to_batch_idx. This is partial fail-closed hardening, not the requested enforced matched or explicitly compact contract for every row-indexed buffer.

tests.what_was_measured: Nine base metadata-plan tests passed; an independent real ForwardBatch construction then recorded planned batch/tokens 3/3, physical 4/4, replan false, and needs_forward_metadata_init false.
13 candidate tests passed, including EagerRunner default-backend rejection and the DSA padding regression.

tests.command: Independent DeepseekSparseAttnBackend.validate_preplanned_metadata_extent adversarial case at candidate commit
tests.what_was_measured: Validator accepted physical_tokens=4 while dsa_seqlens_expanded and token_to_batch_idx each had only 3 rows; these fields are downstream row-indexed metadata but are omitted from validation.
On AMD Instinct MI355X, ROCm 7.2.26015, GPU DSA padding produced [11, 12, 13, 0], matching the independent alignment reference.

gpu_execution.evidence: Candidate GPU reference executed on AMD Instinct MI355X with ROCm 7.2.26015 and matched [11, 12, 13, 0].

remaining_counterexamples: DeepseekSparseAttnBackend.validate_preplanned_metadata_extent accepts a stale four-token execution when dsa_seqlens_expanded and token_to_batch_idx retain three rows, because neither field is checked.
The candidate has no real end-to-end speculative DSA execution proving that every attention/indexer/schedule metadata buffer and KV side effect covers the declared physical extent.
remaining_limitations: No model-weight end-to-end speculative DSA run was available. CUDA-only architectures and distributed workloads were not exercised. The prepared host was AMD Instinct MI355X with ROCm 7.2.26015. PYTHONPATH resolved SGLang from /job/repo/python. No C++/FlyDSL/native source changed, repository-environment.json declares native and wheel null, so no native rebuild was applicable. The prepared checkout exactly matched the recorded base commit.
